parts:
Hi, Phil.

I'm studying cognitive tests with the PISA 2000 dataset for replicate https://www.cse.ucla.edu/downloads/files/Yang_Cai_slides.pdf.

I have dual correct keys within one item.
How can I apply dual keys within one item with key2binary function?

--
Best regards,
Seongho Bae

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: dual keys within one item
parts:
I've run into this before, and in the past I've just used key2binary twice for each key and combined the results via addition. However, the dev version can now handle multiple keys if you supply a matrix instead of a vector. Cheers.

Phil
